name: AI for Business
mood: Brutalist editorial showroom on warm gray with huge uppercase condensed type, flat rounded cards, mint tags, yellow micro-sparks, and tactile 3D product renders.

carbonBlack.role: Primary text, inverted card surfaces, filled blocks, and structural anchors.

graphite.role: Deep surface for code blocks or heavy accents.

slate.role: Secondary body text, navigation labels, and subdued headings.

smoke.role: Secondary body text, meta labels, and icon strokes.

ash.role: Borders, hairlines, disabled states, and neutral structure.

warmCanvas.role: Page background, hero backdrop, and section canvas.

mistGray.role: Secondary surface, nav pill background, and subtle panels.

paperWhite.role: Card surfaces, inverted text on dark blocks, and icon fills.

mintChip.role: Tag pills, link backgrounds, and accent highlights.

voltageYellow.role: Email highlights, small accent dots, and decorative bursts.

fallbacks.display: Anton, Bebas Neue, Barlow Condensed, sans-serif
fallbacks.body: Inter, Sohne, Neue Haas Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif
fallbacks.mono: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, Geist Mono, ui-monospace, monospace

rules: Use SuisseIntlCond-style type for display headings only.
Display headings must be uppercase, weight 700, tight tracked, and line-height 0.9.
Use SuisseIntl for body, nav, subheads, cards, and buttons.
Use SuisseIntlMono for micro labels and metadata.
Do not use condensed display below 48px.

components.name: Filled Dark Button
components.recipe: Carbon Black fill, Paper White text, 8px radius, 16px by 24px padding, SuisseIntl 16px/500.

components.name: Ghost Border Button
components.recipe: Transparent fill, 1.5px Slate border, Slate text, 4px radius, SuisseIntl 16px/500.

components.name: Text Link Button
components.recipe: No background, no border, Carbon Black text, 0-4px radius, underline on hover, SuisseIntl 16px/500.

components.name: Nav Pill
components.recipe: Paper White or Mist Gray floating nav container, 48px radius, centered in 8rem top bar.

components.name: Standard Card
components.recipe: Paper White fill, 24-32px radius, 24px padding, no shadow, no border.

components.name: Inverted Card
components.recipe: Carbon Black fill, Paper White text, 32px radius, no shadow.

components.name: Top Arc Card
components.recipe: 64px top corners and 0px bottom corners, black or white fill.

components.name: Mint Tag
components.recipe: Mint Chip fill, Carbon Black text, 64px radius, compact padding, SuisseIntlMono 12px.

components.name: Voltage Highlight
components.recipe: Voltage Yellow used only for email highlights, accent dots, and decorative bursts.

components.name: 3D Product Render
components.recipe: Photorealistic concrete/wood/branded object render on warm gray canvas.

components.name: Mono Label
components.recipe: SuisseIntlMono 12px, letter-spacing -0.03em, for metadata and system labels.

do: Use SuisseIntlCond 700 at 48px to 130px for all display headings.
Keep display headings uppercase and tightly tracked.
Use Warm Canvas as the page background.
Reserve Mint Chip for tags and link backgrounds.
Reserve Voltage Yellow for email highlights and micro-accents.
Use 16px/500 SuisseIntl for body and buttons.
dont: Do not add shadows to cards or buttons.
Do not use pure white as the page background.
Do not use mint or yellow for large surfaces.
Do not set display heading line-height above 0.95.
Do not use mixed-case display headings.
Do not add subtle borders to cards; prefer surface contrast.

imagery.style: Photorealistic 3D renders of tactile branded objects on a warm gray canvas.
rules: Use textured concrete cubes and wood-grain material.
Use branded labels and colored geometric protrusions.
Keep renders on clean warm gray backgrounds.

layout.structure: Full warm-gray canvas with centered 1200px content, split hero, flat card sections, and black inverted blocks.
layout.navigation: 8rem top bar with centered floating 48px-radius pill.
